equivalence_note: the eager and the jitted public step are advanced from the same initial state in lockstep with the capture. They duplicate the single sanctioned trajectory and exist only to verify that the diagnostic capture reproduces the frozen public step; no physical conclusion is drawn from them and no control arm is run.

frozen_support_edge.rule: the frozen rule reconstructs the contour as linear crossings on grid edges; the edge carrying the t=0 contact-side crossing is tracked by identity so the reconstruction cannot silently hop to a neighbouring edge

linearisation.rule: the normal displacement of an increment dphi measured at the fixed t=0 support point is dn = -(n_phi . n_w) / |grad phi| * dphi, reported in dx units; a positive dn moves the interface toward the solid
